## Invoice exception explainer
Start Procura: npm run dev.
Select your existing credential in Gemini model.
Edit the ID in Choose invoice.
Click Execute Workflow, then open Validate explanation.

This workflow prepares review suggestions. No business records are written.
No public webhook or publishing is needed.
See docs/invoice-explainer.md.
